question: Which Governor-General of British India helped Raja Ram Mohan Roy legally abolish the sati practice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord William Bentinck**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• William Bentinck was the first Governor-General of India.
